seo.title: Docito® Labs — Lab Management, Orders, Results & Referral Workflows
seo.description: Docito® for Laboratories unifies referral-based order intake, slot scheduling, sample tracking, results delivery, and audit-ready workflows—securely connecting labs with doctors, clinics, patients, and insurance.
seo.keywords: lab management system, laboratory workflow software, referral-based lab orders, lab appointment scheduling, lab results delivery, medical diagnostics platform, healthcare referrals, HIPAA compliant lab software, multilingual healthcare SaaS

hero.description: Run lab operations end-to-end: referral-based order intake, slot scheduling, sample tracking, results delivery, analytics, and compliance—built for secure collaboration across the Docito® healthcare ecosystem.
hero.trustNote: Compliance-first, HIPAA/GDPR-ready architecture with role-based access control.
